import numpy as np, cv2
rgb=np.asarray(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
# Build 160x90 chroma/brightness map. Coordinates: block x160-320 y400-1000, ball x560-1020 y380-680.
# Test candidate object geometry: orange block is long vertical with a wide rounded top; ball dark reddish circle.
# find precise visible orange block silhouette by threshold R>100 and red ratio
for thresh in [(70,1.2),(90,1.2),(110,1.15),(130,1.1)]:
 R,rat=thresh;c=rgb.astype(np.int16)
 m=(c[...,0]>R)&(c[...,0]>c[...,1]*rat)&(c[...,0]>c[...,2]*rat)
 ys,xs=np.where(m)
 print(thresh,'bbox', (xs.min(),ys.min(),xs.max(),ys.max()),'count',len(xs))
 # connected component
 n,l,st,ct=cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(m.astype(np.uint8),8)
 print(sorted([(int(st[i,4]),*map(int,st[i,:4])) for i in range(1,n)],reverse=True)[:8])
